title: Degradation: half the ship is gone
summary: xtpd declares the node's operating state (NORMAL, DEGRADED, CONSTRAINED, EMERGENCY) from what it sees first (peerages lost, routes down, witness silent, capacity shrinking) or an operator override, and applies it to every service at once through the Operational Degradation Planner dev5. New opens of a shed class get a DIAG refusal; running sessions of that class are suspended by reconcile(), not killed. fire-control.primary keeps capacity, routes and SORT priority. On degrade xtpd switches to the local emergency text files. Back to NORMAL only when LDAP and the witness are both back. The cats failover and quorum call is part of declaring the state.
authority: design (architecture Tom Dyer; written by Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: Shed by class, live, without restarting listeners
Suspend, do not kill: backup.bulk resumes after recovery
Nothing reaches the wire without passing the operating state
procedure: Declare state in xtpd only; never in an application

provenance.claim: Four operating states, class policy, capacity domains, reconcile() of live contexts
